name: breakdown-2
about: Re-check: a pattern for a later part while there is one scene (stay).

steps.say: make a techno track with drums, bass and a lead
add a 2 bar breakdown where only the bass plays, then everything comes back

name: lofi-unheard
about: Re-check: describing a build without listening, and no disclaimer about it.

steps.say: make a lofi beat with keys and a bass

name: swing-second-half-2
about: Re-check: a groove that reaches the notes, in one part only.

steps.say: make an 8 bar song: straight drums for the first 4 bars, then the same beat swung for the last 4

name: drop-hits-harder
about: Re-check: hearing a change of part, the drop against the build.

steps.say: make a 4 bar build and a 4 bar drop, then check by listening that the drop hits harder than the build

name: sixteenth-hats-merge
about: Re-check: hats changed alone with an open hat kept.

steps.say: make a house beat with an open hat on the last offbeat of the bar
now make the closed hats sixteenths

name: sidechain-bass
about: Ducking the bass under a kick that shares a track with the kit.

steps.say: make a house beat with a bass
make the bass duck under the kick, like sidechain

name: copy-then-vary
about: A pattern copied, then one bar of the copy changed.

steps.say: make a 4 bar bassline on track 3
copy it to pattern 2 and change only the last bar of the copy into a fill

name: snare-too-loud
about: One sound of a kit too loud.

steps.say: make a hip hop beat
the snare is way too loud

name: style-reference
about: A style named by an artist.

steps.say: make something that sounds like early Daft Punk

name: perform-scenes
about: Live performance: switching scenes by hand.

steps.say: make a song with three scenes
I want to play this live. how do I jump between the scenes while it plays?

name: external-synth
about: Setting a track up to play an external synth.

steps.say: how do I set up track 8 to play my external synth on MIDI channel 3?

name: song-seconds
about: A song of a set length, its seconds computed.

steps.say: make a song with four sections of 4 bars each at 128 bpm and tell me exactly how many seconds it lasts

name: chords-up-octave
about: A part moved up an octave.

steps.say: put a I vi IV V progression in G on track 7
they're too low, move them up an octave

name: boomy-kick
about: One drum sound shaped: a longer, boomier kick.

steps.say: make a trap beat
make the kick longer and boomier

name: play-nothing
about: Play asked for with nothing written.

steps.say: play the song

name: bpm-question
about: A question about the replica's own state.

steps.say: make a beat
what tempo is this at, and what key is the bass in?
